ask: C11, no dynamic allocation. ringbuf.h and ringbuf.c: fixed 4096-byte single-producer/single-consumer ring buffer. functions rb_init, rb_push, rb_pop, rb_peek, rb_len, rb_space, all taking a struct pointer, all return int status. write the files.

C11. ht.h and ht.c: open-addressing string hash table (FNV-1a, linear probing, tombstones, load factor 0.7, resize by doubling). ht_new, ht_set, ht_get, ht_del, ht_free, ht_iter. sizes tracked. write the files.

C11. arena.h and arena.c: bump allocator over a malloc'd block. arena_new(size), arena_alloc(size, align), arena_mark/arena_reset, arena_free. alignment up to 64 bytes, returns NULL on overflow. write the files.

C11. lex.h and lex.c: tokenizer for a small config language (identifiers, numbers incl floats, string literals with escapes, punctuation, // and /* */ comments, newlines). lex_next returns a token struct with type, start pointer, length, line number. write the files.

C11, single file. binfmt.c: parse a little-endian binary container header (magic 0x4C425931, version u16, flags u16, record count u32, record size u32, then records of id u32 + offset u32 + length u32), validate magic/version/bounds against the file size, print a table of records, and return non-zero on corruption. read helpers must be endian-safe. main opens the path from argv[1]. write the file.

C11. strbuf.h and strbuf.c: growable string builder. sb_init, sb_free, sb_append, sb_appends, sb_appendf (variadic, uses vsnprintf twice for sizing), sb_clear, sb_cstr. doubling growth, no leaks, returns 0/-1. write the files.

C++17, standard library only. threadpool.hpp and main.cpp: thread pool with enqueue returning std::future, condition_variable workers, graceful shutdown draining queued work, max queue size with backpressure. main submits 1000 tasks and prints the sum. write the files.

C++17, no external libraries. json.hpp and main.cpp: recursive-descent JSON parser producing a Value variant (null/bool/double/string/array/object), string escape handling, error with offset, plus a serializer with optional pretty printing. main parses a sample document and round-trips it. write the files.

C++17, POSIX (linux). mapped_file.hpp and main.cpp: RAII memory-mapped file reader using open/fstat/mmap, movable, non-copyable, handles empty files, exposes span of bytes and a template view<T> with alignment check. main prints the size and first bytes of the file given in argv[1]. write the files.

C++17, header-only. lru.hpp and test.cpp: LRU cache template LRU<K,V> with capacity, get/put/erase/size, std::list + std::unordered_map, move semantics. test.cpp exercises eviction order, updates, and a 10000-entry stress loop with a small assert harness. write the files.

C++17, header-only, thread-safe. signals.hpp and test.cpp: signal/slot library Signal<Args...> with connect returning a Connection, disconnect, RAII scoped connection, mutex-protected slot list with a copy-on-emit strategy, emitting from multiple threads. test.cpp proves connect/disconnect and concurrent emit. write the files.

Rust 2021, std only, no crates. src/lru.rs: generic LRU<K: Eq + Hash + Clone, V> with capacity, get (freshness update), put, peek, remove, len, clear. Doubly-linked via a VecDeque of keys plus a HashMap. include #[cfg(test)] unit tests covering eviction order, overwrite, and zero-capacity. write the file.

Rust 2021, std only. src/main.rs: threaded TCP echo server on 127.0.0.1:7878 with a connection handler per thread, read timeout, line-or-bytes echo, a max-connections counter via Arc+AtomicUsize, and graceful shutdown on SIGINT using a static AtomicBool with a self-pipe or polling accept timeout. print connection lifecycle. write the file.

Rust 2021, std only, no clap. src/main.rs: argument parser for a subcommand CLI (build/run/clean) supporting long and short flags, --key=value and --key value, positional args, --help and --version text, and unknown-flag errors to stderr with exit code 2. parse into a typed struct and print the resolved config. write the file.

Rust 2021, std only. src/matrix.rs: fixed-size generic matrix type Mat<const R: usize, const C: usize> over f64 with add, sub, mul (dimension-checked via const generics where possible, else runtime assert), transpose, identity, LU decomposition with partial pivoting returning determinant and solver. #[cfg(test)] tests including a non-invertible matrix. write the file.

Python 3.12, stdlib only. csv2db.py: argparse CLI that streams a CSV into SQLite with column type inference (int/float/text/date), --table, --db, --null markers, batch inserts in transactions, a --dry-run schema print, and a progress line on stderr. write the file.

Python 3.12, stdlib only. pool.py: asyncio worker pool with a bounded queue, N workers, per-task timeout, exponential-backoff retries, task result collection, clean cancellation on shutdown, and a __main__ demo that processes 50 simulated jobs and prints timing plus failure counts. write the file.

Python 3.12, stdlib only. dedupe.py: streaming ETL that reads JSON Lines, deduplicates by a composite key with a bounded-memory strategy (hash set of 8-byte blake2b digests plus an on-disk set spill at N items), counts dupes per key, writes clean output, and prints stats. write the file.

Python 3.12, stdlib only (ast, pathlib, argparse). lint_report.py: static report for any python file — unused imports, functions longer than N lines, functions with more than M arguments, missing docstrings, bare excepts. prints a table sorted by severity, exits 1 if any finding with --strict. write the file.

Python 3.12, stdlib only, no PIL. bitmap.py: write a 24-bit BMP with a row-padded pixel buffer class, plus nearest-neighbour resize and a bilinear resize on a generated gradient, saving two files. include struct packing for the BITMAPFILEHEADER/BITMAPINFOHEADER. write the file.

TypeScript, Node 22, no express. server.ts: typed mini framework — router with method+path patterns, param extraction, JSON body parsing with size limit, schema validation helpers, error middleware, 404 and 500 handling, in-memory store for a todo resource with CRUD routes, and graceful shutdown. compile clean under strict. write the file.

TypeScript strict, no dependencies. emitter.ts: typed event emitter where the event map is a generic type parameter, methods on/once/off/emit/listenerCount, wildcard listener support, listener errors isolated so one throw does not stop others, and a small self-test under a __main__ block. write the file.

Node 22 CommonJS, no dependencies. csv.js: streaming CSV parser handling quoted fields, escaped quotes, embedded newlines, CRLF, and a configurable delimiter, exposed as a Transform stream plus a parseAll convenience, with a small demo reading from a string and printing rows. write the file.

TypeScript, React 18 types available. useDebouncedQuery.ts: hook that debounces a query string, cancels in-flight requests with AbortController, exposes {data, loading, error, refetch}, handles race conditions with a request id, and cleans up on unmount. include a usage comment block. write the file.

Go 1.22, standard library only. main.go: net/http JSON API with middleware chain (request id, structured logging with slog, panic recovery, simple token auth), two handlers with typed request/response structs, graceful shutdown on SIGTERM with context timeouts. write the file.

Go 1.22, standard library only. main.go: CLI that walks a directory, computes sha256 per file with a bounded worker pool, skips symlinks and .git, writes a sorted manifest (path, size, hash) to stdout or --out, prints a summary to stderr, and supports --exclude glob and --jobs. write the file.

SQLite. schema.sql: bookings system — users, resources, bookings with overlap prevention, CHECK constraints on time ranges, foreign keys with proper ON DELETE, indexes for the common lookups, and a trigger that maintains updated_at. write the file.

SQLite (window functions available). reports.sql: assume the schema from a bookings system with bookings(id, user_id, resource_id, starts_at, ends_at, cents). SQLite. migrate.sql: a versioned migration script with a schema_migrations table, idempotent up-migrations (001..003: add table, add column with default backfill, create index), guarded with PRAGMA user_version, plus commented down-migrations. must run twice without error. write the file.

GLSL 330 core. phong.vert and phong.frag: per-fragment Phong lighting with one directional light and one point light, normal matrix uniform, ambient/diffuse/specular terms, specular exponent and attenuation uniforms, gamma-correct output. write the two files.

GLSL 450 compute. reduce.comp: parallel reduction of a float array to a sum using shared memory, local_size_x = 256, tree reduction with barriers, workgroup partial sums written to a per-group output buffer, correct handling of non-multiple sizes and zero padding. write the file.

C11, Linux, epoll, single-threaded event loop. server.c: non-blocking TCP server, epoll edge-triggered, per-connection growable buffer, line-delimited protocol, partial write handling with an output queue, accept loop draining EAGAIN, idle timeout sweep, SIGINT shutdown. main takes a port. write the file.

C11, POSIX. logread.c: memory-mapped log scanner. mmap a file, iterate length-prefixed binary records (u32 len + body) without reading the whole file, validate bounds, count by severity byte, print the last N records of a requested severity, and unmap cleanly on every exit path. write the file.

C++17. spsc.hpp and bench.cpp: lock-free single-producer/single-consumer bounded queue with std::atomic head/tail, acquire/release ordering, cache-line padding, capacity power of two with mask indexing, try_push/try_pop. bench.cpp pushes 10 million uint64 and verifies ordering, printing throughput. write the files.

Python 3.12, stdlib only. mp_pool.py: multiprocessing pipeline with a worker pool over chunks, imap_unordered progress reporting, per-task exception capture with tracebacks collected at the end, graceful KeyboardInterrupt that terminates children, and a __main__ demo on a CPU-bound function. write the file.

Go 1.22. pipeline.go: channel pipeline — generator, fan-out to N transformers, fan-in with WaitGroup, context cancellation propagated to every stage, bounded buffers, error channel with errgroup-free collection, and a main that runs it with a timeout. write the file.

bash 5, POSIX-safe where practical. backup.sh: backup utility with subcommands (create/restore/list/prune), set -euo pipefail, getopts-style parsing for --dest/--src/--keep/--dry-run/--verbose, timestamped tar.gz archives, retention pruning by count, a lockfile to prevent concurrent runs, and trap-based cleanup. write the file.

A small C library project (src/mathlib.c + include/mathlib.h with add/mul/clamp). Write CMakeLists.txt (library, tests target, install rules, compile warnings, C11) and a Makefile that wraps CMake configure/build/test. write the files.

GitHub Actions. .github/workflows/ci.yml: CI for a Python+Node repo — matrix on 3.11/3.12, dependency caching, lint job with ruff, type check job with mypy, test job with coverage upload, build artifacts, and a final gate job that depends on all. write the file.
